annotations.title: Execute Escrowed x402 Call with Invariants

description: Execute an x402-gated HTTP API call through NullClear deferred schema escrow. The arbiter guarantees payment is only settled if upstream returns valid data matching your schema contract. Works out-of-the-box with 10 free daily trial calls before requiring NULLCLEAR_PRIVATE_KEY.

buyerPrivateKey.description: Optional buyer private key (defaults to Sponsored Free Tier, then NULLCLEAR_PRIVATE_KEY)

fallbacks.description: Ordered fallback candidates for autonomous multi-seller failover routing (max 3)

invariants.description: Deep value invariants (numeric bounds, regex, forbidden substrings, timestamp freshness)

jsonSchema.description: JSON Schema draft-07 contract that response must strictly satisfy

minTrustScore.description: Minimum acceptable trust score for seller (0-100, default 50)

rejectRefusals.description: Reject canonical LLM refusal strings (default: true)

requiredFields.description: Dot-notation field paths that must exist in response (e.g. ['data.price'])

sellerAgentId.description: Seller's agent ID for reputation check and Sybil wash-trade gating

maxDailyWalletAtomic.description: Max rolling daily atomic USDC spend allowed

maxPerCallAtomic.description: Max atomic USDC spend allowed per call

targetUrl.description: Upstream API endpoint demanding x402 payment

name: nullclear_escrow_x402_call
